metrics.name: mc_bedrock_players_by_device
metrics.help: Bedrock players by device (android, ios, windows, xbox, ps4, nx...).

metrics.name: mc_bedrock_players_by_input
metrics.help: Bedrock players by input mode (keyboard_mouse, touch, controller, vr).

metrics.name: mc_bedrock_players_linked
metrics.help: Bedrock players whose account is linked to a Java account.

metrics.name: mc_build_info
metrics.help: Always 1. The version is in the labels, the Prometheus idiom for publishing a string.

metrics.name: mc_exporter_background_task_age_seconds
metrics.help: Age of a background collector's last successful run. Tells "nothing changes" apart from "nothing is measuring".

metrics.name: mc_exporter_collector_duration_seconds
metrics.help: Duration of one collection, per collector.

metrics.name: mc_exporter_collector_info
metrics.help: Always 1, one per active collector. source is where its numbers come from: "core" for what the server exposes itself, otherwise the plugin name.

metrics.name: mc_exporter_player_series_dropped
metrics.help: Players whose detail is NOT published because of the collector.players.max_series cap. A non-zero value means per-player metrics are incomplete.

metrics.name: mc_exporter_scrape_duration_seconds
metrics.help: Time spent answering a scrape. If this grows, the exporter is the problem.

metrics.name: mc_exporter_scrape_errors_total
metrics.help: Collections that threw. A failing collector does not stop the others.

metrics.name: mc_exporter_up
metrics.help: 1 once the exporter has finished starting.

metrics.name: mc_host_cpu_periods_total
metrics.help: Elapsed scheduling periods. The ratio with throttled_periods gives the share of throttled time.

metrics.name: mc_host_cpu_quota_cores
metrics.help: CPU quota, in cores. NaN when no limit is set, in which case throttling cannot happen.

metrics.name: mc_host_cpu_system_seconds_total
metrics.help: CPU time in kernel space.

metrics.name: mc_host_cpu_throttled_periods_total
metrics.help: Periods during which the kernel FROZE the container for lack of quota. A rising value explains low TPS that spark does not see.

metrics.name: mc_host_cpu_throttled_seconds_total
metrics.help: Total time spent frozen by the kernel.

metrics.name: mc_host_cpu_usage_seconds_total
metrics.help: CPU time used by the container.

metrics.name: mc_host_cpu_user_seconds_total
metrics.help: CPU time in user space.

metrics.name: mc_host_disk_files
metrics.help: Number of files under the path.

metrics.name: mc_host_disk_free_bytes
metrics.help: Free space on the mount point.

metrics.name: mc_host_disk_total_bytes
metrics.help: Size of the mount point.

metrics.name: mc_host_disk_usage_bytes
metrics.help: Size of the contents, computed by walking the tree. Measured in the background, never on scrape.

metrics.name: mc_host_io_bytes_total
metrics.help: Bytes read and written, per device.

metrics.name: mc_host_io_operations_total
metrics.help: Disk operations, per device.

metrics.name: mc_host_memory_bytes
metrics.help: Memory breakdown. type = anon|file|kernel|sock.

metrics.name: mc_host_memory_limit_bytes
metrics.help: Container memory limit.

metrics.name: mc_host_memory_oom_events_total
metrics.help: Out-of-memory events. type = oom (allocation refused) | oom_kill (process killed). The latter is always an incident.

metrics.name: mc_host_memory_page_faults_total
metrics.help: Page faults. type = minor|major.

metrics.name: mc_host_memory_usage_bytes
metrics.help: Memory used by the CONTAINER, JVM heap included.

metrics.name: mc_jvm_buffer_pool_bytes
metrics.help: Off-heap buffers. They count toward CONTAINER memory but not the heap, a classic cause of unexplained OOM kills.

metrics.name: mc_jvm_classes_loaded
metrics.help: Loaded classes.

metrics.name: mc_jvm_gc_collections_total
metrics.help: Collections run, per garbage collector.

metrics.name: mc_jvm_gc_seconds_total
metrics.help: Cumulative collection time. This is collection time, NOT stop-the-world time; for actual pauses use JFR or GC logs.

metrics.name: mc_jvm_memory_bytes
metrics.help: JVM memory. area = heap|nonheap, state = used|committed|max|init.

metrics.name: mc_jvm_memory_pool_bytes
metrics.help: Memory per garbage collector pool (Eden, Survivor, Old, Metaspace).

metrics.name: mc_jvm_threads
metrics.help: JVM threads. state = live|daemon|peak|started.

metrics.name: mc_jvm_threads_deadlocked
metrics.help: Deadlocked threads. Any non-zero value is an incident.

metrics.name: mc_jvm_uptime_seconds
metrics.help: Time since the JVM started.

metrics.name: mc_proxy_backend_max_players
metrics.help: Player slots advertised by the backend in its ping response.

metrics.name: mc_proxy_backend_ping_seconds
metrics.help: Backend ping response time, as seen from the proxy.

metrics.name: mc_proxy_backend_players
metrics.help: Players per backend server.

metrics.name: mc_proxy_backend_up
metrics.help: 1 if the backend answers the ping, 0 otherwise. The only outside view: a server that is down no longer publishes its own metrics.

metrics.name: mc_proxy_connections_total
metrics.help: Connection attempts. result = pre_login|login|disconnect.

metrics.name: mc_proxy_kicks_from_server_total
metrics.help: Players kicked by a backend server.

metrics.name: mc_proxy_pings_total
metrics.help: Server list pings: clients LOOKING at the server without joining. A measure of attention, not load.

metrics.name: mc_proxy_player_ping_seconds
metrics.help: Ping distribution between players and the proxy.

metrics.name: mc_proxy_players_by_brand
metrics.help: Players by advertised client brand.

metrics.name: mc_proxy_players_online
metrics.help: Players connected to the proxy.

metrics.name: mc_proxy_server_switches_total
metrics.help: Moves from one server to another. from = "none" on first connection.

metrics.name: mc_server_blocks_total
metrics.help: Blocks broken and placed. action = break|place.

metrics.name: mc_server_chat_messages_total
metrics.help: Chat messages.

metrics.name: mc_server_commands_total
metrics.help: Commands run. The label is limited to a fixed list of commands, everything else is "other", to bound cardinality.

metrics.name: mc_server_connections_total
metrics.help: Joins and quits. result = join|quit.

metrics.name: mc_server_deaths_total
metrics.help: Player deaths, by cause.

metrics.name: mc_server_items_crafted_total
metrics.help: Items crafted.

metrics.name: mc_server_mob_deaths_total
metrics.help: Mobs killed. Only kills BY A PLAYER count: a skeleton burning in the sun says nothing about server activity.

metrics.name: mc_server_player_ping_seconds
metrics.help: Ping of an online player.

metrics.name: mc_server_player_playtime_seconds
metrics.help: Total playtime of an online player.

metrics.name: mc_server_player_statistic
metrics.help: A vanilla statistic, per player. Published while the player is online, which is enough since nothing happens offline.

metrics.name: mc_server_player_statistics
metrics.help: Sum of a vanilla statistic over ONLINE players. Drops when they leave: a gauge, not a counter.

metrics.name: mc_server_players_by_brand
metrics.help: Players by advertised client brand. A mod can fake it: it describes honest players, not cheaters.

metrics.name: mc_server_players_by_locale
metrics.help: Players by client locale.

metrics.name: mc_server_players_max
metrics.help: Player slots advertised by the server.

metrics.name: mc_server_players_online
metrics.help: Online players.

metrics.name: mc_server_players_ping_seconds
metrics.help: Ping distribution of online players.

metrics.name: mc_server_playtime_seconds_total
metrics.help: Cumulative playtime of all online players.

metrics.name: mc_server_session_seconds
metrics.help: Session length, measured on quit.

metrics.name: mc_server_tick_average_seconds
metrics.help: Average tick duration, as computed by the server.

metrics.name: mc_server_tick_duration_seconds
metrics.help: Tick duration distribution. 0.05 s is the threshold: above it the server falls behind. This is THE alerting signal.

metrics.name: mc_server_ticks_total
metrics.help: Ticks since startup.

metrics.name: mc_server_tps
metrics.help: Ticks per second, capped at 20. window = 1m|5m|15m. Do NOT alert on it: it only moves once the server is already behind.

metrics.name: mc_world_chunks_loaded
metrics.help: Loaded chunks.

metrics.name: mc_world_entities
metrics.help: Loaded entities.

metrics.name: mc_world_entities_by_type
metrics.help: Entities by type. Collected in the background, and only types above the threshold are published, to keep cardinality bounded.

metrics.name: mc_world_players
metrics.help: Players in the world.

metrics.name: mc_world_tile_entities
metrics.help: Loaded tile entities: chests, furnaces, hoppers. Hoppers are the first cause of heavy ticks on a build server.

metrics.name: mc_world_time_ticks
metrics.help: World time, in ticks.

metrics.name: mc_world_weather
metrics.help: Weather. 0 = clear, 1 = rain, 2 = thunder.
